name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: FRESH-GSMFIELDS-RETRY BUILD (v6): the new detailed logging (0.5.4) immediately found a real bug -- a MOZ_LOG capture showed the delayed (5s) post-send reinitCertVerifier() never firing at all, correlated with the user closing the compose window right after a successful send (completely normal). It used win.setTimeout(), a window-scoped timer that Gecko silently cancels along with all of that window's other pending timers when the window closes. Switched to the module-level setTimeout (imported from Timer.sys.mjs), which isn't tied to any compose window's lifecycle -- the whole point of this reinit is fixing global NSS state for reading mail in other windows, so it needs to survive the compose window closing.
